title: Improve Goal Tree Display Information
description: Improve the goal tree command output to show more and better structured information including slug, status, creation date, due date, and description.
summary: Improved goal tree display to show more information: status, createdAt (relative time), due date, and full description. Updated both text and markdown templates. Added `description` field to all three GraphQL query variants in the goal tree command. Fixed backwards-compatible parsing of the old `started`/`finished` flat fields in Interaction JSON unmarshalling so that `createdAt` resolves correctly for goals with legacy interaction format. Added Status and CreatedAt to the goal tree view model.
